summary: U.S. GoldMining Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a board-approved extension of its publicly traded warrants from May 11, 2026, to May 22, 2026. The warrants, exercisable at $13.00 per share, were initially issued on April 24, 2023, and have been extended multiple times. No other terms changed. Continental Stock Transfer remains warrant agent. The filing is a routine administrative action with no special-situation catalyst, deal structure, premium, or strategic change. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring.
